content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for RDWU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by Rama Devi Women's University (RDWU), Bhubaneswar, Odisha for academic positions under the Integrated Teacher Education Program.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in RDWU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available for the position of Assistant Professor in Liberal Discipline and Pedagogy across different subjects.

faq.question: Q3. What are the specific subjects available for the Assistant Professor posts?
faq.answer: The vacancies are available in three subjects: History, Political Science, and Economics under Liberal Discipline and Pedagogy.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for RDWU Faculty positions?
faq.answer: The mode of application is purely through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates do not need to submit any online or offline application forms prior to the interview date.

faq.question: Q5. When is the scheduled date for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 12 October 2026. Candidates must report for document verification by 9:30 a.m.

faq.question: Q6. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Post-graduate degree in Social Sciences/Humanities (History/Political Science/Economics) with a B.Ed. degree and NET, State Level Eligibility Test, or Ph.D.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 65 years. There is no lower age limit specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary offered for selected candidates?
faq.answer: Selected candidates with a Ph.D. will receive Rs. 40,000/- per month, whereas UGC-NET qualified candidates will receive Rs. 35,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring the filled application format, original documents, self-attested photocopies of mark-sheets, educational certificates from 10th onwards, Aadhar Card, and other relevant documents in A4 size.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the walk-in interview take place?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview and document verification will take place at the Chamber of VC Board Room (Administrative Block) at Rama Devi Women's University.
